character: Serre Chevalier Vallée is a long linked ski area above the Guisane valley between Briançon and Le Monêtier-les-Bains, with about 250 km of pistes and 82 runs, including much tree-lined terrain. Its bases are traditional villages (Briançon, Chantemerle, Villeneuve and Le Monêtier) rather than a purpose-built station.
learning: Serre Chevalier has 15 green and 26 blue runs (search summary). Reference: beginner areas are at the valley bases and mid-mountain; confirm beginner-lift access and lessons for 2026-27.
